name: GBFSBench MV-Rad v1.1
description: Corrected 290-task release with explicit missingness, ranking, distance and semantic contracts; visualization tasks retired.

system.label: MV-Rad / Nextbike feed id nextbike_um
notes: The benchmark is evaluated on a frozen single-system snapshot.
free_bike_status.json is included as a derived augmentation preserved in the bundled snapshot.
v1.1 normalizes system_information.time_zone to timezone; see snapshot normalization.json.

license: See LICENSE_DATASET.txt. Code is covered by the repo license.

grading_contract.expected_null: Only an explicitly returned answer:null matches; missing result, missing answer, exception, string null and NaN must fail.
grading_contract.numeric_tolerance: Absolute tolerance recorded per task; no relative tolerance.
grading_contract.exact_integer: Integral numeric equality, not truncation of fractional values.
grading_contract.task_identity: version plus task fingerprint; never resume changed tasks by ID alone.
